title: Settlement of Home-Visit Service Charges by Card — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Settlement terms

The service charges of a collected home visit are settled together by one card payment, taken with a method the visit type accepts and recorded against the visit's assessed trip fee; once that payment is taken the visit's trip, additional-patient and weekend charges are settled and nothing more is collected for them.

Service charges of a collected home visit that were not charged to a card when the collection was completed stay open on the visit and are settled when the patient asks to pay them, by the home-visit settlement payment.

These terms apply to the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of **Specimen Collection Appointments**, whose accepted cards are credit card, debit card and HSA/FSA card.

## When the settlement charge is taken

The home-visit settlement charge is taken only after the trip fee assessed on the visit stands on its fee record.

No home-visit settlement charge is taken until the visit carries the assessed additional-patient fee owed for the household members drawn at it.

For a visit dated on a Saturday or Sunday, the home-visit settlement charge is worked out only after its assessed weekend surcharge is on the fee record.

## Payment tool: `pay_home_visit_fees_e8e0d8a4`

**Capability.** The patient pays, with their own card, the settlement charge for the service charges (trip, additional-patient and weekend) of a collected home collection visit. One call records one card payment, dated today, against the visit's assessed trip-fee line and marks the visit's collection-fee balance as settled (0.00); the patient sees the payment in the visit's fee history and nothing further is owed for those service charges.

**Invocation.** A patient-side tool: the agent unlocks `pay_home_visit_fees_e8e0d8a4` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the patient) runs it with their own card.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `visit_id` | The reference number of the home collection visit being settled, as the agent reads it from the visit lookup and gives it to the patient | Identifier |
| `assessed_event_id` | The reference number of the visit's assessed trip-fee line the payment is recorded against, as listed in the visit's fee history | Identifier |
| `fee_amount` | The settlement charge to put on the card, in USD, exactly as the agent states it | Positive amount, 2 decimal places (cents) |
| `payment_method` | The card the patient pays with | One of `credit_card` (a credit card), `debit_card` (a debit card drawn on a bank account), `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings account or flexible spending account card) |

**Return.** A receipt with `visit_event_id` (the reference number of the new payment line), `visit_id` (the visit settled), `assessed_event_id` (the trip-fee line the payment is recorded against), `fee_amount` (the amount charged to the card, USD, 2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the card type used), `event_date` (today's payment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `fee_balance` (the visit's collection-fee balance after settlement, 0.00). A receipt carrying a `visit_event_id` means the payment was taken.
